title: First to the Fold
desc: Sheep walk all by themselves. Watch the flock trot down the gentle step and into the red barn.
tut: Sheep never wait for instructions: they walk, turn at walls and fall off edges.
This flock needs no help. Watch them find the barn — then the real work begins.
On your remote: the arrows move the cursor and the view follows it. Rewind and Fast Forward change the skill in hand, and OK gives it to the sheep in the ring. Play/Pause freezes time while you aim.
